storage: Airtight jar at room temperature, away from damp and strong smells; in monsoon keep a dry spoon in use. Do not refrigerate.
looksLike: White, glittering, free-flowing crystals of sucrose, sold loose or in 500 g, 1 kg and 5 kg pouches.
howToPick: Dry, loose, uniformly white crystals with no lumps, no yellow tint and no damp patches. Avoid hardened clumps (moisture) or a sour or smoky smell.
shelfLife: Effectively indefinite if kept dry (general guidance; not from a source in this run); packs carry a best-before date.
